name: Anchovies
siboNotes: Anchovies are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. The high salt content may help with electrolyte balance during digestive healing.
preparationTips: Rinse canned anchovies to reduce excess salt if desired
Mash into paste for Caesar dressing or sauces
Add to low-FODMAP pizza or pasta dishes for umami flavor
Store opened canned anchovies covered in oil in refrigerator
nutritionalHighlights: High in omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA
Good source of niacin and vitamin B12
